What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The vertex of a downward-opening parabola is the highest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/f7c76977ce34ad88089ee05f33aeb70f64593c1f96ade92d6c832c5e795f902e.png)

  

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(4,-1).$
